{"reason": "Both stockout rows (medium, 5.3d alt-lead=7; 2.8d alt-lead=4) had the supplier arriving too late. alert-planner costs 35000 vs 45000 and always arrives in time, so changing branch 2's action to alert-planner saves 10000 on each of the 34 supplier-switches and eliminates supplier-lateness stockouts (195000→35000), lowering both cost and stockouts.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
